feedback.message: Preserve EffectIntent/runtime-authority separation for DB effects. APP-03 local evidence supports host-injected resource adapters but not production sandbox authority.
BASE compile-first policy strengthened: tested DB CRUD/transaction class needed lowering/adapter work, not a new core primitive. G9 spec/grammar conformance remains independent blocker.
Activation/relevance does not become DB transaction authority.
U2 semantic-vs-placement split gains bounded executable support: one Clay semantic IR can delegate transaction mechanics to a concrete adapter while keeping resource instance outside semantic hash.
DB commit/rollback receipts are downstream runtime effects, not evidence of selection uptake/re-entry by themselves.
No new higher-order topology primitive required for the tested exact DB transaction path.
Transaction correctness is not emergence evidence.
Add future differential acceptance coverage for DB commit/rollback, error equivalence, parameter binding, adapter authority, crash recovery and multi-backend semantic identity.

APP-03 has a concrete non-promoted executable path: focused source -> parsed subset -> canonical IR -> deterministic Python target -> real SQLite adapter; 500 fuzz transactions, 0 reference mismatches.
